title: SerreSectionModuleConstruction
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x_0,x_1] with its total-degree grading, and P=Proj S as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. For every O_P-module G, there is an S-module M internally graded by additive subgroups M_z (z in Z), vanishing for z<0, with additive isomorphisms M_z to Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0, intertwining multiplication by every homogeneous polynomial a in S_e with G tensor twistMul(z,a). Here O_P(z) and twistMul are the twisting sheaves and multiplication maps of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. No coherence or finite generation is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Take the explicitly defined serreSectionSum with the explicit scalar action. The action-law theorem supplies only proofs of the module laws and the single-summand action formula, so the carrier and scalar data are genuine constructions. Let M_z be the range of the z-th direct-sum injection.

The equivalence E_z between B_z and the injection range is AddMonoidHom.ofLeftInverse of the component evaluation. Componentwise mapping by E_z inverse identifies the canonical recomposition map with an additive equivalence; therefore the ranges are internal. In negative degrees PLift(0≤z) is empty, hence every function is zero and its injection range is bottom.

For z≥0 evaluate E_z inverse at the unique proof of 0≤z to obtain phi_z; its inverse is the constant function, giving an additive equivalence. The single-summand action formula proves homogeneous stability after commuting e+z=z+e. Applying E_(z+e) inverse and evaluation to the formula proves exactly the target compatibility with the twisting map.
